fact: Exiled journalist Zineb Haddaji tells CIVICUS Lens that opposition and exiled media websites are blocked in Djibouti and social media access is restricted at times of political tension.
Opposition party RADDE says police arrested a journalist and a cameraman of its citizens' rights programme at their homes on 20 November 2025.

The US State Department says authorities arrested Farhya Houssein on 25 June 2024 for online criticism of the government and a court sentenced her on 17 July 2024 to one month in prison and two years' probation.

The US State Department says the government owned the only radio and television stations and the newspaper La Nation held a monopoly on authorized print media, with official media generally not criticising government policy.
